title: NetTest
summary: Network tester: link status, switch & port via LLDP/CDP, ping and DNS checks
description: NetTest turns the CardputerZero into a pocket network tester. The Ethernet page shows link state, speed and duplex, IPv4/IPv6 address, gateway, DNS and MAC, plus the switch name, port, VLAN and management IP the switch advertises over LLDP or CDP, so you can find out where a wall jack goes. The Wi-Fi page shows SSID, signal strength and addresses. The Tests page pings the gateway and 1.1.1.1, queries every configured DNS server directly, and checks internet access over TCP 443, with a one-line verdict. Use the 4/5/6 keys for the Ethernet, Wi-Fi and Tests pages, Up/Down to switch interfaces, 7 to re-run the checks and 8 for light/dark mode. Vibecoded with Claude Code.
